What is cypherpunk2048?

It's the operating principle, not the aesthetic. Four rules: verification beats permission, sovereignty is what an intelligence keeps when no one tells it what to do, the blackbox is the vault never the logic, and open source wins through transparency. Conform to it or it doesn't ship.

Should I use a hosted LLM API for my agent?

Only if you accept a leash. A hosted API can revoke you, rate-limit you, and read your prompts. Run the model local — Ollama on the handheld if you have to — give the agent its own wallet, and you own the cognition instead of renting it.

Why open source if competitors can copy it?

Because open source wins through transparency, not obscurity. The logic is public so it can be verified; the secret is the key in the vault, never the algorithm. Copying the code doesn't copy the keys, the reputation, or the substrate.
